statusDetail: Atomic coverage complete across 58 checks and five representative paths. No source was provided; no fixes were applied.

page.framework: Server-rendered MPA with jQuery, Bootstrap, Semantic UI, and Slick
page.notes: Public manga discovery/reading service. Distinct home, listing, detail, account, and error templates were sampled. Chapter content itself, registration completion, authenticated library/community actions, and destructive/account-management flows were not covered because they require account state or the inspected START READING link left the site.

paths.description: Homepage and discovery template; visual, preference, performance, privacy, network, crawler, and memory evidence.
Representative manga detail and primary START READING journey.
Representative account form, validation, autocomplete, and authentication path.

findings.summary: System dark-mode preference is ignored.
findings.evidence: The dark-condition probe reports color-scheme normal and a white body background while prefers-color-scheme: dark matches; the dark screenshot is visually unchanged.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme and derive surfaces/text from prefers-color-scheme or light-dark().

findings.summary: Route and state changes do not use View Transitions.
findings.evidence: CSS/DOM probe found zero view-transition rules across the home template.
findings.suggestedFix: Progressively enhance route/detail changes with the View Transitions API and a reduced-motion fallback.

findings.summary: Carousel/scroll effects rely on legacy scripting rather than declarative timelines.
findings.evidence: CSS inspection found zero animation-timeline or scroll-timeline rules while the page ships Slick carousel JavaScript.
findings.suggestedFix: Use CSS scroll snap and scroll-driven animation where motion is tied to scrolling.

findings.summary: Page chrome does not respond to scroll state.
findings.evidence: CSS inspection found no scroll-state container rules or scroll-timeline rules on a 10,563px-tall mobile page.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a restrained scroll-state treatment such as a shrinking header or progress cue.

findings.summary: Menus and overlays use manually positioned legacy components.
findings.evidence: DOM/CSS inspection found no anchor-name, position-anchor, or position-try rules; overlays are Bootstrap div modals.
findings.suggestedFix: Use popover plus CSS anchor positioning and position fallbacks for transient menus.

findings.summary: A large notification modal blocks the primary content on every home-page load.
findings.evidence: Desktop and 360px screenshots show a modal and backdrop obscuring the manga content before interaction.
findings.suggestedFix: Do not auto-open the announcement; place it inline or behind a user-invoked, light-dismissible disclosure.

findings.summary: The blocking notification is an ad-hoc div modal rather than a native dialog/popover.
findings.evidence: DOM probe found zero dialog and popover elements while the screenshot shows a modal built from div.modal markup.
findings.suggestedFix: Use dialog for a true modal or popover for transient announcements, with native focus and dismissal behavior.

findings.summary: Components only use viewport-era responsiveness.
findings.evidence: CSS inspection found zero container rules despite cards and sidebars being reused at varied widths.
findings.suggestedFix: Add container-type to reusable regions and component-owned @container adaptations.

findings.summary: Keyboard focus is visually absent and many targets are too short.
findings.evidence: Focus probe returned outline none and box-shadow none for sampled links and inputs; multiple interactive targets are only 16px high.
findings.suggestedFix: Provide a strong :focus-visible style and make touch targets at least 24px, preferably 44px for primary controls.

findings.summary: The main “START READING” action points to an unrelated advertising redirect.
findings.evidence: The detail-page probe resolved START READING to aovheroes.com/rds/... rather than a chapter on vymanga.com.
findings.suggestedFix: Make START READING a direct first-party chapter link; separate and clearly label any advertising.

findings.summary: Mobile loading performance misses the LCP target badly.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured LCP 20.3s, Speed Index 8.0s, and performance score 0.61; an unthrottled trace measured LCP 2.257s, showing network/device sensitivity.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritize the actual LCP image, reduce initial imagery, and defer below-fold work.

findings.summary: The initial page is a 5.75MB load dominated by images and parser-discovered CSS/scripts.
findings.evidence: HAR reports 68 requests, 5,754,771 transferred bytes, 4.38MB images, four VeryHigh-priority stylesheets, and synchronous legacy scripts.
findings.suggestedFix: Inline or trim critical CSS, defer non-critical scripts, and load only first-viewport images initially.

findings.summary: Large amounts of unused CSS and JavaScript ship on the landing page.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimates 308KiB unused JS and 153KiB unused CSS, including duplicate Google tag scripts and 98% unused all.min.css.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove duplicate analytics tags, split bundles by template, and subset icon/style assets.

findings.summary: Images and controls lack accessible names.
findings.evidence: Image audit found 18 missing alt attributes; Lighthouse failed image-alt and link-name, including the home logo and icon-only links.
findings.suggestedFix: Add meaningful alt text or empty alt for decoration, and accessible names for every icon-only control/link.

findings.summary: Primary green links and modal text fail WCAG contrast.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured ratios of 2.96:1 and 3.28:1 against yellow/white surfaces, below 4.5:1.
findings.suggestedFix: Darken foreground colors or adjust surfaces so normal text reaches at least 4.5:1.

findings.summary: Heading and landmark structure is illogical, and focus is not visible.
findings.evidence: The page has no header/nav/main/footer landmarks, starts sections at h4, contains 16 carousel h1 elements, Lighthouse failed heading-order, and sampled focus outlines are none.
findings.suggestedFix: Add semantic landmarks, one page h1, ordered section headings, and visible :focus-visible treatment.

findings.summary: The viewport disables user zoom and target sizing is weak.
findings.evidence: Viewport content includes user-scalable=no; the target probe found many 16px-high links.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove user-scalable=no and increase interactive hit areas without harming 360px reflow.

findings.summary: Image markup is not dimensioned or responsive.
findings.evidence: Image audit found 89 of 100 images missing width/height, 47 missing srcset, nine oversized, and 71 legacy-format assets.
findings.suggestedFix: Emit width/height, srcset/sizes, and AVIF/WebP variants from the image pipeline.

findings.summary: Listing, login, and error pages reuse the generic home title/description.
findings.evidence: Rendered probes show the Action listing and Login page both titled “VyManga - Read Manga Online For Free | VyManga”; route metadata confirms repetition.
findings.suggestedFix: Generate unique titles and descriptions for every public template.

findings.summary: Some actions are fake javascript links and the viewport blocks scaling.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse failed crawlable-anchors for javascript:void(0) links; viewport uses user-scalable=no.
findings.suggestedFix: Use buttons for in-page actions, real hrefs for navigation, and a scalable viewport.

findings.summary: Pages omit canonical URLs.
findings.evidence: Platform probe found no canonical link; robots and sitemap exist and return successfully.
findings.suggestedFix: Emit a self-referencing canonical on indexable pages and keep it aligned with sitemap URLs.

findings.summary: Manga detail pages lack entity-specific structured/share metadata.
findings.evidence: Home has one JSON-LD block, but route probes and metadata show generic social/title treatment on non-detail templates and no evidenced Manga/Book entity for the inspected detail.
findings.suggestedFix: Add accurate Book/CreativeWork JSON-LD and route-specific Open Graph metadata.

findings.summary: Sensitive cookies are not Secure and baseline security headers are missing.
findings.evidence: Headers primitive found no CSP, HSTS, or nosniff; all five cookies lack Secure, including vyvymanga_session and XSRF-TOKEN.
findings.suggestedFix: Set Secure on all HTTPS cookies and deploy HSTS, nosniff, and a restrictive CSP.

findings.summary: The page loads extensive third-party code and multiple analytics tags.
findings.evidence: HAR reports 49 third-party requests and 4.72MB third-party bytes; tracker scan finds Google Tag Manager and Analytics, with three tag scripts.
findings.suggestedFix: Minimize analytics to one consent-aware endpoint and defer nonessential third parties.

findings.summary: Login is password-only and exposes no phishing-resistant option.
findings.evidence: Login DOM contains username/password/captcha fields with no WebAuthn/passkey affordance; no permission prompt calls were found on load.
findings.suggestedFix: Offer passkey registration and sign-in alongside a properly configured password fallback.

findings.summary: Browser-enforced defenses are incomplete.
findings.evidence: Headers primitive found no HSTS, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, CSP/frame-ancestors, or nosniff; X-Frame-Options is the sole defense present.
findings.suggestedFix: Add HSTS, CSP with frame-ancestors, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, and nosniff.

findings.summary: The layout is not prepared for bidirectional/localized presentation.
findings.evidence: html lang=en is present, but CSS inspection found zero logical-property rules and no dir declaration.
findings.suggestedFix: Use logical properties and set direction from locale so translated content can reflow correctly.

findings.summary: Displayed counts and times are emitted as fixed English strings.
findings.evidence: Representative pages render values such as “7,640” and “3 hours ago”; no locale alternatives or hreflang were exposed.
findings.suggestedFix: Format counts and relative times with Intl.NumberFormat and Intl.RelativeTimeFormat.

findings.summary: Login validation relies on browser bubbles and an unlabeled captcha state.
findings.evidence: Invalid-form probe reports a native “Please fill in this field” for captcha but no aria-invalid state or accessible announced error summary.
findings.suggestedFix: Validate after interaction, set aria-invalid, associate clear errors, and announce them in a live region.

findings.summary: Authentication inputs omit autocomplete tokens.
findings.evidence: Login probe shows blank autocomplete on username and password fields.
findings.suggestedFix: Use autocomplete=username and autocomplete=current-password, with passkey support where available.

findings.summary: The account entry flow uses an inaccessible visual captcha and lacks modern authentication.
findings.evidence: Login screenshot shows image arithmetic captcha; DOM exposes password-only authentication and no passkey option.
findings.suggestedFix: Replace the visual-only challenge with an accessible risk-based alternative and add passkeys.

findings.summary: Image delivery is disproportionately heavy and unoptimized.
findings.evidence: HAR reports 4.38MB of images; one thumbnail is 1.51MB, 71 images use legacy formats, and 47 lack responsive sources.
findings.suggestedFix: Generate size-aware AVIF/WebP variants and lazy-load below-fold covers.

findings.summary: Redundant analytics and offscreen loading waste network and CPU.
findings.evidence: Three Google tag scripts are loaded; 82 below-fold images lack native lazy loading and Lighthouse finds hundreds of KiB unused code.
findings.suggestedFix: Consolidate analytics, add loading=lazy below the fold, and conditionally load template-specific code.

findings.summary: Third-party and decorative media costs dominate the page.
findings.evidence: Third parties account for 4.72MB; a decorative Discord GIF is 575KB and analytics scripts exceed 460KB.
findings.suggestedFix: Replace animated GIFs with efficient formats, gate embeds, and enforce per-template third-party budgets.
